recommendation: Do not promote any A050 candidate (all screens clearly negative: SN_B -0.078, SN1_B -0.040). Report the mechanism: a page-lattice CC sniper is a strong new weapon (+0.060 [+0.035,+0.085] vs a matched no-bomb control, gains in every group, biggest vs zrl03/ah02/zchain4/MOVSW teams), but captured zombies are too valuable as an early replicator to carry it (the delay costs ~-0.10). A future role could look for a cheaper carrier (for example a few bombs per generation, or a member-side burst limited to a few hundred turns), screened with the same read-instead-of-write control.
